scope: Italy wind commercial network and adjacent renewable execution ecosystem
principles: Company-level capability never closes a project execution scope by itself.
Only project-specific A1/A2 evidence can close an execution scope.
Association membership, company websites, press releases and LinkedIn are discovery/commercial intelligence unless tied explicitly to a project award.
The network registry is broader than the canonical project contractor graph: it includes target companies worth approaching or monitoring even when no canonical project link is yet proven.
Adjacent renewable players can be commercially relevant without being classified as proven utility-scale wind BoP contractors.

signals: new project award or EPC/BoP contract
WTG order, delivery, installation or commissioning
new Italian wind project or acquisition
new operating site, depot or hiring wave relevant to wind construction

discovery_sources.name: ANEV member universe
discovery_sources.use: monthly sector-player census and discovery; membership is not project-award evidence

discovery_sources.name: Company press/news/investor-relations pages
discovery_sources.use: weekly/fortnightly award, backlog, project-start and capability signals

discovery_sources.name: OEM order press releases
discovery_sources.use: WTG supply, transport, installation, commissioning and service signals

discovery_sources.name: MASE / regional / municipal project documents
discovery_sources.use: project-specific evidence and contractor attribution when explicit

discovery_sources.name: Company LinkedIn posts
discovery_sources.use: lead source only unless direct project execution is explicitly stated and corroborated where needed
